notes.title: Space Fist v1.0.3 Update！
notes.content:
Update:
-Add new branch story.
-Add game options : Voice.
-Add trial tower's floor display and reset function after complete trial tower.
-Add new achievements and hidden achievements.
-Optimize some texture and model.

Fixes:
-Fixed : LAN failure if computer name have non english characters.

Thank you for everyone's support!

notes.title: Space Fist v1.0.2 Update！
notes.content:
Update:
-Now support Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch.
-Add Game Options UI, you can change Language,Picture Quality and Subtitle Display.
-Optimize defense decision to give players a more realistic defense experience.
-Optimize the enemy's move to prevent the enemy attack too close.
-Enhance the sense of attack, heavy attack will have more feeling.

Fixes:
-Fixed : no helmet award on trial tower.

Thank you for everyone's support!

notes.title: Space Fist v1.0.1 Update！
notes.content:
[b]Update:[/b]
-Prevent overlap with enemy's body.
-Optimizing some attack action.
-Optimizing enemy's combo attack,you can easy defensive counterattack.
-Slightly adjusted the difficulty value,you can play easily.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed : Not play on Windows 7 systems without DX11.1 runtimeupdate.
-Fixed : Can't read config file on a few computer.

Thank you for everyone's support!
